name: jusi-neovim

scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run prepare:linux-icons && electron-builder --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:x64: npm run build && npm run prepare:linux-icons && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:providers: nvim --headless -u NONE -l scripts/test-providers.lua && nvim --headless -u NONE -l scripts/test-native-child.lua && nvim --headless -u NONE -l scripts/test-browser-status.lua && nvim --headless -u NONE -l scripts/test-browser-location.lua
scripts.check: npm run harness && npm test && npm run test:markdown && npm run test:providers && npm run test:packages:native && npm run test:workers && npm run test:documents && npm run smoke:live
scripts.test:documents: nvim --headless -u NONE -l scripts/test-document.lua && nvim --headless -u NONE -l scripts/test-selection.lua
scripts.test:workers: nvim --headless -u NONE -l scripts/test-workers.lua && node scripts/test-worker-lifecycle.mjs && nvim --headless -u NONE -l scripts/test-worker-documents.lua && nvim --headless -u NONE -l scripts/test-worker-navigation.lua && nvim --headless -u NONE -l scripts/test-worker-snapshots.lua
scripts.dist:linux:portable:x64: npm run build && npm run prepare:linux-icons && electron-builder --linux tar.gz --x64 --publish never

description: Neovim presentation host with optional rich content providers
